title: 내모남불 ③ 주식편 · 오르면 · 내리면 · 단톡방

lines.en: It's up! My eye never misses.
Dad, your friend's went up too.
That's luck. Mine is skill.

lines.text: 내가 오르면 실력, 남이 오르면 운. 내모남불, 하나.
lines.en: Mine goes up: skill. Yours goes up: luck. Double standard, number one.
I'm… Modapman.

lines.text: 사건 개요. 평일 오후, 동네 은행. 대기 번호 47번.
lines.tts: 사건 개요. 평일 오후, 동네 은행. 대기 번호 사십칠 번.
lines.en: Case summary. Weekday afternoon, the local bank. Ticket number 47.

lines.text: 오늘은 모라구 통장 만드는 날이야. 주식 얘기 금지.
lines.en: Today's about opening Moragu's account. No stock talk.

lines.text: 내 건 오르고, 남의 건 좀 내리고. 그게 공평하지.
lines.en: Mine goes up, theirs dips a bit. That's fair.
That is not fair.

lines.tts: 딱 세 판만 하죠. 일 라운드, 오르면.
lines.en: Just three rounds. Round one: when it goes up.
What did you look at before buying?
Your dad reads charts.
You bought it because the name sounded cool.
…But I had a feeling. So what~
Double standard, number two.
This is called the self-serving bias.
Self… what?
Customer number 47.
One sec, this is important!

lines.text: 오르면 실력, 내리면 세력. 다들 그러십니다.
lines.en: Up means skill, down means "someone rigged it." Everyone says that.
Round two: when it goes down.
Huh? Why's it blue? (Blue means down here.)
The market's rigged. Someone's behind this!
That's exactly what the bank lady said.
Dude… mine's completely blue…
Told you so~

lines.text: 어? 근데 싸졌네? 나도 한번 사볼까?
lines.en: Wait, it's cheap now? Should I buy some?
Honey, your friend is literally crying.
Double standard, number three.
The pain of losing outweighs the joy of winning.
So should I buy or not?
I recommend absolutely nothing.
Round three: the family group chat.
My cousin posted his gains.
Ugh… my stomach suddenly hurts.
Dad, why does your tummy hurt?
Because his cousin went up.

lines.text: 저런 걸 왜 올려? 자랑이야, 자랑.
lines.en: Why post that? He's just bragging.

lines.text: 빨간 것만 잘라서… 이건 정보 공유야. 모 어때~
lines.en: Crop out the blue… This is just sharing info. So what~
Double standard, number four.

lines.text: 사촌분이 올랐다고, 고객님 것이 줄지는 않습니다.
lines.en: Your cousin going up doesn't make yours any smaller.
The only thing that shrank is your heart.
…Huh?

lines.text: 아빠, 나 통장 생겼어. 엄마랑 만들었어.
lines.en: Dad, I got my own bankbook. Mom and I made it.

lines.text: 아빠는 친구 아저씨 거 내리면 좋아?
lines.en: Are you happy when your friend's goes down?
…No. Of course not.

lines.text: 친구가 오르면, 친구 기분도 같이 오르잖아.
lines.en: When your friend goes up, his mood goes up too.
…You're right. I should say congrats.
Now, let's check my skills again…
…It's all blue?

lines.text: 우리 집 계좌는 빨갛던데. 그거 내가 산 거야.
lines.en: Our family account is red. I bought those.
…When?

lines.text: 당신이 이름 보고 살 때, 나는 공부했지.
lines.en: While you picked by name, I did my homework.

lines.text: 이건 내모남불이 아닙니다. 그냥 오답. 모범답안은, 엄마.
lines.en: That's not a double standard. Just a wrong answer. The model answer: Mom.

lines.tts: 사십칠 번 고객님 업무는, 사모님이 끝내셨습니다.
lines.en: Customer 47's business was handled by your wife.
…Classic Modapman.
